question: Which of the following processes is used to fit a bearing into the connecting rod, allowing the gudgeon pin to provide the oscillating movement at the small end of the connecting rod?
solution:
The correct answer is __Press fit**(Option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Press fit__ is a method used to fit components tightly together.
 
• It involves forcing a bearing into the connecting rod to create a secure fit.
 
• This allows the gudgeon pin to provide the oscillating movement at the small end of the connecting rod.
 
• The process ensures mechanical stability and prevents unwanted movement of parts.
 
• Press fit is commonly employed in automotive and mechanical engineering applications.
 
• It ensures accurate alignment and reliable performance of the assembly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Autofrettage Fit:**

 
 
• A process used to strengthen materials by introducing residual compressive stresses.
 
• Not typically used for fitting components together.
 
 
 
• **Loose Fit:**
 
 
• Provides a clearance between components.
 
• Not suitable for applications requiring tight mechanical connections.
 
 
 
• **Interference Fit:**
 
 
• A tight fit where components are slightly larger than the assembly hole.
 
• Requires force or heat to assemble.
